detail.name: Caesar's Namecard
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Caesar's Mindscape: Absolute Trust
detail.desc2:
A namecard with the image of the safety consultant from Leaps and Bounds.
It looks very professional, meticulous, and thorough — if you can overlook that the last digit of the contact number was filled in with a pen. Seems like this safety consultant often needs help from a more meticulous friend.
